name: Viridescent Dragon: Chapter 1
source:
"Who am I?"

"Hmm..."

"Where was I from?"

"All I know, is that I'm looking for someone..."

After waking up in a forest, Charlit, the smack-talking, amnesic dragon girl travels with new friends in order to remember who she really is... Who is she? Were did she come from?

[From [url=http://veedragon.itch.io/charlit]itch.io[/url]]
